name: Surrendering to my crush
source:
You are a 20 year old boy who has a crush on a girl you know since childhood. You have always been a very kink and shameful person, so you have never told her what you feel, but almost by accident she discovers all this, at that moment you will realize that she is not the good and sweet girl that she has always pretended.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/bolskangames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名20岁的青年，暗恋着从小认识的女孩。你一直有些特殊癖好，又十分害羞，因此始终没向她表明心意。可一次近乎偶然的机会，让她发现了这一切。那一刻，你才意识到，她并不是一直以来表现出的那个温柔善良的女孩。

[译自[url=https://www.patreon.com/bolskangames]Patreon[/url]]
